reason: A browser-side DeepSeek Harness web plugin for opening and sharing sessions through URL-based deep links while synchronizing the active session in the address bar.

summaries.zh: 通过 URL 深链接打开、分享并同步 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端中的会话。
summaries.en: A browser-side DeepSeek Harness web plugin for opening, sharing, and synchronizing sessions through URL deep links.

capabilities: Opens a specified DSH session from a URL query parameter
Synchronizes the active session identifier with the browser address bar
Preserves unrelated URL query parameters and fragments
